make_cfg: build a habitat-sim simulator configuration with color, depth, and semantic camera sensor specs from a settings dictionary
make_simulator_from_settings: create a habitat-sim simulator instance with physics enabled and load object template configs from settings
simulate: run the habitat-sim physics simulation for a given number of world seconds at 60Hz and collect observations
sample_object_state: sample a random valid non-colliding placement for a rigid object on the navmesh or within a bounding box
ContinuousPathFollower: build a continuous path follower that interpolates waypoints along a geodesic path for agent navigation
